page.title: Help center
page.description: Guides for every module, day-to-day actions, and VetSaaS FAQs.
page.empty: No results. Try another word (WhatsApp, prescription, signature, register…).
page.footer: Need more help? Use the in-app assistant or contact your plan support.

sede.title: Create your first branch
sede.summary: Without an active branch you cannot use register, appointments, or inventory.
steps: Go to Settings → Branches.
Click «New branch» and fill in name and address.
Keep the branch active and save.

clinic.title: Clinic details
clinic.summary: Tax ID, legal name, logo and colors for PDFs and messages.
steps: Open Settings → General → My clinic.
Fill in tax ID, legal name, and trade name.
Upload the logo and pick colors (sidebar and PDFs).

firma_digital.title: Digital signature on PDFs
firma_digital.summary: Vet stamp at the bottom of prescriptions, records, vaccines and authorizations.
steps: Settings → General → Digital signature (below the logo).
Upload the stamp image. White paper is removed automatically.
Enter the veterinarian name and CMVP number.
Check which PDFs should show it: prescriptions, visit, history, booklet, vaccine application, authorizations.
Save. Sale tickets and cash audits do not use this stamp.

autorizaciones.title: Authorization documents
steps: Settings → Authorizations: create or edit the template.
Send the document to the owner from clinical care.
The owner signs; the PDF can also show the clinic vet stamp if enabled.

usuarios_roles.title: Users and permissions
usuarios_roles.summary: Each person signs in with a role; the menu follows their permissions.
steps: Settings → Roles: decide what each profile can do.
Settings → Users: create users and assign a role.
If someone cannot see a module, the role is usually missing the permission.

tarifas.title: Fees and clinical catalog
tarifas.summary: Prices for services and packages charged in visits or at the register.
steps: Settings → Fees.
Review clinical, grooming or hotel services for your plan.
Visit charges use these prices.

horarios.title: Schedule hours and blocks
horarios.summary: When booking is allowed and closed days or hours.
steps: Settings → General: first and last visible agenda hour.
Settings → Hours: rules by day or clinician.
Settings → Blocks: holidays, leave or maintenance.

modo_asesora.title: Advisor mode (several clinics)
modo_asesora.summary: For teams that treat pets coming from multiple origin clinics.
steps: Settings → General → enable Advisor mode.
Clinic → Advised clinics appears for the origin catalog.
On each pet you can record which clinic it comes from.

sala_espera.title: Waiting room
sala_espera.summary: Today’s board: arrived, in care, waiting.
steps: Open Waiting room in the main menu.
Mark arrival or move to care.
Use it on a tablet at reception.

propietario.title: Register an owner
propietario.summary: Phone and details used for WhatsApp, prescriptions and sales.
steps: Clinic → Owners → new record.
Save names and a valid mobile number (Peru: 9 digits or 51…).
Without a phone you cannot send prescriptions, tickets or campaigns.

paciente.title: Register a patient
paciente.summary: The pet is the center of appointments, records, prescriptions and sales.
steps: Clinic → Patients.
Create or select the owner.
Add species, breed and basics. Then open records, vaccines or prescriptions.

cita.title: Schedule an appointment
cita.summary: By veterinarian and branch, with WhatsApp reminders if enabled.
steps: Clinic → Appointments: date, time, patient and clinician.
Save. You can reschedule, cancel or open a visit.
In General, enable create/reschedule notices and reminders (1–30 days and 2 h).

consulta.title: Medical record and visit
consulta.summary: Document the visit and download PDFs for the owner.
steps: From an appointment or Medical records, open or create the visit.
Record reason, exam, plan and charges.
Use the visit PDF or the full patient history PDF.

receta.title: Create a prescription
receta.summary: Drugs, posology and a PDF for the owner.
steps: Clinic → Prescriptions → New prescription.
Pick patient, date, status (draft or issued) and add drug lines.
You can link inventory and an open visit. Then PDF / print from the row menu.

receta_whatsapp.title: Send a prescription via WhatsApp
receta_whatsapp.summary: The green icon on the row sends the PDF to the owner’s phone.
steps: Clinic WhatsApp must be connected (Communications → Outbox).
On Prescriptions tap the green bubble (it is not in the three-dot menu).
Confirm or change the number and send. Voided prescriptions cannot be sent.

vacuna.title: Vaccinations and booklet PDF
vacuna.summary: Doses, next due date, stock and owner document.
steps: Clinic → Vaccinations: patient, vaccine and date.
If the product comes from inventory, stock is deducted.
Download the booklet or that application PDF. They can show the digital stamp.

laboratorio.title: Lab and results via WhatsApp
laboratorio.summary: Exam orders and files sent to the owner.
steps: Clinic → Laboratory: create the order and attach results.
When files exist, send via WhatsApp (same flow as sales).
The owner receives the attachments with a clinic caption.

cirugia.title: Surgeries
steps: Clinic → Surgeries.
Record patient, procedure and status.
You can link a visit and register charges.

hospitalizacion.title: Hospitalization
steps: Clinic → Hospitalization.
Admit the patient with reason and branch.
Add progress notes and close the stay on discharge.

agenda_servicios.title: Grooming and hotel calendar
agenda_servicios.summary: Bookings for grooming slots and hotel stays.
steps: Services → Calendar.
Check the day and open the slot or stay.
Reminders (1 day, 2 h, etc.) are set in General → Notifications.

grooming.title: Grooming
grooming.summary: Slots, statuses and process photos via WhatsApp.
steps: Services → Grooming: create the slot with service, date and pet.
Move to in progress / completed; the owner can get WhatsApp updates.
In General choose which grooming notices are on (create, process, done, cancel, no-show).

hotel.title: Hotel
hotel.summary: Stays, daily log and owner notices.
steps: Services → Hotel: book check-in and check-out.
Confirm, check in, complete or cancel.
Daily log WhatsApp can be enabled in General.

sesion.title: Open a register session
sesion.summary: You need an open session to record sales for the shift.
steps: Register → Sessions → Open register.
Choose branch and opening float if needed.
At close you can print or download the cash-up PDF / ticket.

venta.title: Record a sale
venta.summary: Charge products and services from the POS.
steps: With register open, Register → Sales → New sale.
Add lines, customer and payment method.
Confirm. Then you can view, void or issue a SUNAT receipt.

venta_whatsapp.title: Send a sale ticket via WhatsApp
venta_whatsapp.summary: Green icon on the sales list (same idea as prescriptions).
steps: Clinic WhatsApp connected.
On Sales tap the green bubble (not on voided sales).
Confirm the owner number and send the ticket PDF.

pagos.title: Payments and receivables
pagos.summary: Later collections or installments linked to sales.
steps: Register → Payments.
Link the payment to the pending sale or document.
A register session may be required.

descuentos.title: Discounts
steps: Register → Discounts: create the discount and rules.
Apply it on a line or the total when selling.

producto.title: Add products
producto.summary: The catalog feeds sales, stock, prescriptions and vaccines.
steps: Inventory → Products → New product.
Set SKU, prices, category and whether it tracks stock.
Drugs can later be linked on prescriptions.

stock.title: Check stock
steps: Inventory → Stock.
Filter by branch or search by name.
Check lots (FEFO) if the product uses them.

movimientos.title: Inventory movements
movimientos.summary: In, out, adjustments and transfers between branches.
steps: Inventory → Movements.
Set type, product, quantity and branch.
You keep an audit trail for reports.

alertas.title: Stock alerts
steps: Inventory → Alerts.
Review below-minimum or soon-to-expire items.
Purchase or adjust to clear the alert.

proveedores.title: Suppliers
steps: Inventory → Suppliers.
Create the supplier with tax ID.
Use them when recording purchases.

compra.title: Record a purchase
compra.summary: Bring goods into inventory at real cost.
steps: Inventory → Purchases → New purchase.
Choose supplier, branch and lines.
Confirm to update stock (and lots if used).

fel.title: Set up SUNAT e-invoicing
fel.summary: Issue electronic receipts according to your plan.
steps: Settings → General → Billing tab.
Enable SUNAT issuance if the plan allows it. Support configures the APISUNAT token.
Set VAT, tax treatment and whether prices include tax.

series.title: Receipt series
steps: Invoicing → Series.
Create the series for invoice or receipt type.
Link it to the branch.

comprobantes.title: Issued receipts
comprobantes.summary: SUNAT status, PDF and WhatsApp resend.
steps: Invoicing → Issued documents.
Filter by date or type. Check accepted or rejected.
You can send the e-receipt via WhatsApp if a phone is on file.

notas_baja.title: Void notices and daily summaries
steps: Invoicing → Void notices or Summaries.
Follow sent / accepted status.
Do not void by hand a document already reported to SUNAT; use this flow.

whatsapp_conectar.title: Connect clinic WhatsApp
whatsapp_conectar.summary: One number for reminders, outbox, campaigns, prescriptions and tickets.
steps: Communications → Outbox: connect or sync the session.
Scan the QR with the clinic phone.
The chip should say Connected. A 429 pause is a list-API cooldown; sending can still work if the session is ready.

cola.title: Outbox and retries
steps: Outbox: review pending. «Send now» fires delivery.
History: already sent; you can resend to the same number.
Failed: fix the phone or reconnect WhatsApp and retry.

campanas.title: WhatsApp campaigns to owners
campanas.summary: Broadcast with daily cap, interval and Peru (Lima) window.
steps: Communications → Campaigns → new: name, message, cap (max 100/day) and interval (1–30 min).
Send window uses Lima time (e.g. 09:00–23:59). Outside the window nothing is sent.
Pick recipients in the modal (people already sent in that campaign are not repeated).
WhatsApp must be connected. After it finishes you can add more owners without resending.

historico.title: Message history
historico.summary: Audit of sent items: prescriptions, tickets, reminders, campaigns.
steps: Communications → History.
Filter by type or recipient.
Resend if the original was delivered and you need it again.

plantillas.title: Reminder templates
plantillas.summary: Copy for appointments, vaccines, grooming and hotel. Sales, lab and prescriptions stay fixed.
steps: Communications → Templates.
Edit the body with variables (pet, date, clinic).
Prescription, ticket and lab sends are not edited here.

chat_interno.title: Internal team chat
chat_interno.summary: Messages between clinic users and the support group.
steps: Communications → Internal chat.
Open a 1:1 chat or a team group.
You can attach files where the chat module allows it.

bot_ia.title: Client AI assistant (WhatsApp)
bot_ia.summary: Automatic replies on the clinic number, if your plan includes it.
steps: Communications → AI assistant: turn replies on or off.
Load clinic knowledge (hours, services).
General also has a bot-replies switch.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
steps: Reports → Snapshots.
Create or open the date cut.
For internal meetings; it does not replace financial reports.

financiero.title: Sales and cash reports
financiero.summary: Financial analysis, products, services, income and expenses.
steps: Reports: pick the report (financial, by product, services, expenses, top patients).
Filter the date range.
Export or print from that screen.

instalar_app.title: Install VetSaaS on phone, tablet or PC
instalar_app.summary: You can install the system as an app (PWA) from the browser.
steps: Open VetSaaS in Chrome or Edge (iPhone: Safari).
Use the install banner or the browser menu → Install / Add to Home Screen.
Always use your clinic subdomain.
The app uses the same user and permissions as the web.

app_splash.title: The app stays on the logo when opening
app_splash.summary: White screen with the green icon and «VetSaaS»: usually installed-app cache.
steps: Wait a few seconds: after an update it may reload once by itself.
If it does not enter after 10 seconds, tap «Tap to continue» to clear cache.
If there is no button, fully close the app and open it again (once is enough in most cases).
Last resort: remove the shortcut and install again from the browser.

offline.title: Working with a weak signal (offline)
offline.summary: Register, clinic and inventory can be cached if you opened them online first.
steps: With internet, open Register, Clinic or Inventory at least once.
Offline, you will see outbox notices. Sync resumes when the signal returns.
Pending queue: Offline / queue depending on your role.
Login, dashboard and platform are never served from cache on purpose.

faq_splash.title: Why do I sometimes have to open the app twice?
faq_splash.summary: After a VetSaaS update the background worker can take over mid-load.
steps: You should no longer need to close twice: the app reloads itself when it detects the update.
If it still freezes, use «Tap to continue» or swipe the app away and open again.
Older Android tablets are slower the first open of the day; use stable Wi‑Fi.

faq_whatsapp_campana.title: The campaign does not send or stays pending
faq_whatsapp_campana.summary: Check Lima hours, interval, cap and that WhatsApp is connected.
steps: Send clock is America/Lima, not a mis-set phone timezone.
Outside the from–to window nothing is sent.
Daily cap max 100; interval min 1 minute.
A 429 pause is often the status API; sending can still work if the session is ready.
After a campaign ends, add more owners: already-sent people are not repeated.

faq_whatsapp_sesion.title: WhatsApp disconnects or reminders do not go out
faq_whatsapp_sesion.summary: The OpenWA session must be ready; reminders fire in time windows.
steps: In Outbox, sync status. If you see a QR, link the same number again.
The 2 h appointment reminder fires near that time, not when you created the appointment.
History can resend; Outbox «Send now» for pending or failed.
The clinic WhatsApp phone needs internet; avoid extreme battery saver.

faq_receta_enviar.title: I cannot send a prescription via WhatsApp
faq_receta_enviar.summary: Green row icon, not voided, and an owner phone.
steps: Sending is the green bubble, not the three-dot menu.
Voided status cannot be sent.
The owner needs a mobile number. You can type another number in the modal.
Clinic WhatsApp must be connected, same as sales.

faq_firma.title: The signature shows a white box on the PDF
faq_firma.summary: Upload the stamp again: white paper is stripped on save.
steps: Settings → General → Digital signature: upload the image again.
Generating the PDF also cleans the background of a stored image.
Check the documents where it should print. With no checks it will not appear.

faq_caja.title: I cannot sell or take payment
faq_caja.summary: Almost always there is no open register session for that branch.
steps: Register → Sessions: open the register on the same branch as the sale.
Close a stuck previous session if needed.
Check that your role has sales and session permissions.

faq_recordatorios.title: How do I turn on appointment, vaccine and service reminders?
faq_recordatorios.summary: All of it is in Settings → General → Notifications.
steps: Enable 2 h before and the day options (1, 2, 3, 7, 30) for appointments and for grooming/hotel.
Vaccines: choose how many days before the suggested date to notify.
WhatsApp must be connected. Copy is edited in Communications → Templates.
